'''CZ-1''' was a [[CZ-series secretary/comm droid]] constructed by [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc.]] CZ-1 was modified to resemble the [[Stacchati/Legends|Stacchati]] that he served at one time. He was formerly CZ-0R6 before a memory wipe and was connected to another droid called [[CZ-3/Legends|CZ-3]].

CZ-1 was separated from his twin unit, [[CZ-3/Legends|CZ-3]], after a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] crash on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Not long afterward, CZ-1 broke down in the desert and was captured by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], ending up in the [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] of [[Nebit/Legends|Nebit's]] tribe. The droid's [[Locomotor/Legends|locomotors]] were severely damaged, but CZ-1 was optimistic and hoped to be repaired and eventually sold. When [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were reunited aboard the Jawa sandcrawler, CZ-1 sat lifelessly in a corner.<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
CZ-1 appeared in the first ''[[Star Wars]]'' film, released in [[1977]], albeit unnamed.<ref name="Episode IV" />

His parts were the same suit used by [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] actor [[Anthony Daniels]] for [[CZ-3/Legends|CZ-3]].<ref name="I am">''[[I Am C-3PO: The Inside Story]]''</ref>
